item.title: Implementation of Section 51A of UAPA, 1967: Updates to UNSC's 1267/ 1989 ISIL (Da'esh) & Al-Qaida Sanctions List: Amendment of 03 Entries
item.description:
RBI/2026-27/302
DoR.AML.REC.254/14.06.001/2026-27

October 27, 2026

The Chairpersons/ CEOs of the Commercial Banks,
Small Finance Banks, Payment Banks, Urban Co-operative Banks

Madam/Dear Sir

Implementation of Section 51A of UAPA, 1967: Updates to UNSC's 1267/ 1989 ISIL (Da'esh) & Al-Qaida Sanctions List: Amendment of 03 Entries

Please refer to Chapter IX of the Reserve Bank of India - Know Your Customer, Directions, 2025 dated November 28, 2025, as per which, regulated entity shall ensure that in terms of section 51A of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) (UAPA) Act, 1967, it does not have any account in the name of individuals / entities appearing in the lists approved by the United Nations Security Council (UNSC).

2. In this connection, Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), Government of India has informed about the UNSC press release SC/16490, dated October 26, 2026 wherein the Security Council amended three entries on its ISIL (Da'esh) and Al-Qaida Sanctions List subject to the assets freeze, travel ban and arms embargo.

5. In view of the above, regulated entities are advised to take appropriate action in terms of Chapter IX of the aforementioned Directions and strictly follow the procedure as laid down in the UAPA Order dated February 02, 2021 (amended on April 22, 2024) annexed to the Directions.

8. Regulated entities are advised to take note of the aforementioned UNSC communication and ensure meticulous compliance.

Yours faithfully

(R Sathish)
General Manager

item.title: Re-organisation of districts in the NCT of Delhi – Assignment and Review of Lead Bank Responsibility
item.description:
RBI/2026-27/300
FIDD.CO.LBS.BC.No.12/02.08.001/2026-27

October 26, 2026

The Chairman / Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer
Lead Banks concerned

Madam/ Dear Sir,

Re-organisation of districts in the NCT of Delhi

The Government of National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi has notified re-organisation of districts in the NCT of Delhi, whereby three new districts, viz., Old Delhi, Central North and Outer North have been formed and Shahdara district has ceased to exist.

2. Lead Bank responsibilities in the newly created districts have been assigned as follows:

Sr. NoNewly Created DistrictLead BankDistrict Working Code
1.Old DelhiCanara Bank03E
2.Central NorthState Bank of India03F
3.Outer NorthPunjab National Bank03G

3. Lead Bank responsibility of the Northwest district has been reviewed and assigned to Union Bank of India in place of Punjab National Bank.

5. In the remaining districts, the existing Lead Banks shall remain unchanged, till further communication.

Yours faithfully,

(Nisha Nambiar)
Chief General Manager-in-Charge

item.title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Eleventh Amendment Directions, 2026
item.description:
RBI/2026-27/297
DOR.CAP.REC.251/21-02-002/2026-27

October 23, 2026

Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Eleventh Amendment Directions, 2026

Please refer to Chapter VII: Leverage Ratio framework of the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Directions, 2025. To ensure alignment with the latest leverage ratio framework issued by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, there is a felt need to amend these Directions.

(2) The minimum leverage ratio for a domestic systemically important bank (D-SIB) shall be 4 per cent and 3.5 per cent for other banks. Branch of a global systemically important bank (G-SIB) in India shall maintain a leverage ratio of 3.5 per cent plus the leverage ratio buffer applicable to it as a G-SIB.

(5) Both the capital measure and the exposure measure are to be calculated on a quarter-end basis. However, a bank may, subject to the Reserve Bank's approval, use more frequent calculations (e.g., daily or monthly averaging) as long as it does so consistently.

(6) A bank shall meet the minimum leverage ratio requirement at all times.

270. A bank shall publicly disclose its quarterly Basel III leverage ratio both on a standalone and consolidated basis.

(Sunil T S Nair)
Chief General Manager
